title: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, Guangzhou
geometryBasis: Sixteen native footprint controls and the municipal heritage section establish an octagonal central hall and four attached, double-eaved ranges. The south view and same-day façade detail control the curved blue tile, gilded crown, crimson columns and dark red woodwork.
sectionBasis: Heights are architectural estimates relative to the main landing. Guangzhou’s park authority gives 48.63 meters for the building height. The independent surface near the site varies substantially and needs separate ground-contact review.
limitations: May 2013 main hall. Detached gate, garden structures, monument and statue are outside the exterior asset.
Roof tier sections, mouldings, inscriptions, and individual glazing bays are approximate where the accepted images provide incomplete coverage.

The original terrain samples are preserved. The renderer clips the source surface inside the estimated granite apron to clear the hall and entrance steps. Retaining edges and local thresholds are approximate.

mappedRoofAndPorticoControls.notes: The mapped octagonal crown, glazed drum and eight portico column centers set the horizontal section. The municipal architectural height sets the vertical control.
